cards.title: Container images as release artifacts: every service published and pinned, compose runs from images
Agent Studio Docker-deployable: one compose file runs the complete product from published images
Rehearsal and production cutover to the remote Task Server, with rollback drill and detached-Studio proof
Installer: one executable for Windows and Linux that installs Agent Studio on Docker or as native services
Deployment regression scenario: one reduced, deterministic end-to-end run that every deployment card and every release must pass
LinkSupervisor: the Task Server owns the SSH reverse tunnel to agent-runner-01, silently
Link migration: adopt the running forward, seven-day soak, retire AgentRunner-TunnelKeeper

Concept: the Task Server as the bus between the orchestrator engine and the runner and review daemons (make AGT-W49 explicit; many runner-host agents, no separate workstation agent, quality as pipeline steps)
Concept: the deployment story from one box to many runners, as the operator's and administrator's journey (workstation = one-box Docker special case)
